segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: As Jesus came near Jerusalem, he sent two disciples ahead into the village with a strange errand.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me. And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Go into the village, he told them. Untie them and bring them to me. And if anyone asks why, just say the Lord needs them — and he'll let them go.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: They went, and it happened exactly as he said. And all of it was exactly as the old prophecy had said, too.

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The King was coming — but not the kind they expected.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The crowds spread their cloaks on the road, and cut branches from the trees, and lined his path.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And the people shouted as he rode in:

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: Hosanna to the son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Hosanna means save us now. They were calling him King out loud, in the street, where everyone could hear it.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The whole city was stirred. When they asked who this was, the crowd answered plainly.

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this? And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Who is this? the city asked. And the answer came back from the road — this is Jesus, the prophet, out of Nazareth in Galilee.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He came not with swords but with peace — riding on a donkey, the humble King the scriptures had promised.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The King rode in on a donkey, not a warhorse. His kingdom is peace. You're welcome in it.
